name: Shared Identity
body:
Share another’s social talents.

Prerequisite(s): Dual identity class feature.

Benefit(s): You and another creature with this feat can choose to share each other’s social and vigilante identities. This allows you to impersonate and use that creature’s social and vigilante identities as if they were your own, as well as allowing them access to yours as if it were their own.
